summary: The RNG annotation points to attrib.c:exercise, but the missing caller is timeout.c:slime_dialogue. After the green-slime attack establishes the Slimed timeout, js/timeout.js:nh_timeout records a gap instead of running the source countdown. Port the complete dialogue and its consumed pure predicate closure; the function's unconditional exercise(A_DEX,FALSE) explains the first RNG mismatch and its countdown messages explain the later screen mismatch.

source.branch: Whole-function scope at timeout.c:389-443. Read Slimed & TIMEOUT, update the final-tick disguise, emit odd-tick countdown text with the source blindness and body-form gates, apply the i==3, i==2 and i==1 state transitions, then call exercise(A_DEX,FALSE) unconditionally. The selected path enters from nh_timeout with Slimed active.
callers: Direct source caller: timeout.c:nh_timeout:625-626 calls slime_dialogue when Slimed is nonzero. Current js/timeout.js:nh_timeout records note_unported('timeout.c slime_dialogue') at that branch.
Runtime entry: allmain.c:moveloop_core calls nh_timeout once per elapsed turn; js/allmain.js:finishElapsedTurn calls js/timeout.js:nh_timeout in the corresponding turn tail.
dependencies: attrib.c:exercise is a void state/RNG dependency called unconditionally after the dialogue switch; the JavaScript implementation already exists and must be called in the same position.
eat.c:Popeye returns the Boolean consumed by the i==3 occupation branch; its SLIMED path uses include/obj.h:polyfood, mon.c:pm_to_cham, and engrave.c:can_reach_floor for accessible floor tins.
engrave.c:can_reach_floor consumes trap.c:uteetering_at_seen_pit and trap.c:uescaped_shaft; these pure Boolean results determine whether a floor tin can prevent occupation interruption.
include/youprop.h:Blind includes intrinsic and extrinsic blindness unless blocked; the i==4 message gate must use the canonical effective-blindness predicate.

evidence: challenges/evaluations/20261005192202-v18.json records 68/107 screens, 2540/2630 RNG calls, and 76/107 cursors matched. Its first RNG mismatch is C exercise(attrib.c:509) rn2(2) at step 62 while JavaScript has advanced without the timeout dialogue's exercise call; the first screen mismatch is a missing countdown glyph at step 64.

Upstream timeout.c:slime_dialogue spans lines 389-443 and ends with unconditional exercise(A_DEX,FALSE). timeout.c:nh_timeout calls it at lines 625-626 whenever Slimed is active; current js/timeout.js has a source-named gap in that branch.

The same admitted case reaches the active Slimed timeout after uhitm.c:mhitm_ad_slim. Source review of the full dialogue identifies eat.c:Popeye as its consumed return-value dependency and the pure can_reach_floor, pm_to_cham, uteetering_at_seen_pit, and uescaped_shaft closure needed by that predicate.
